BN Acres offers our community a local source for grassfed beef, lamb, eggs, honey, and more. We have farmed this land for over 150 years, recognized North Carolina Century Farm. Our beef is Certified Animal Welfare Approved, the only USDA-approved 3rd-party certification animal welfare label.

About Our Products

If you are interested in our meat products, honey or anything else we are here to serve you and your family with quality!  All of our meat is packaged in freezer sealed bags that are flash frozen by our butcher.  The freezer bags will last for years if handling is minimized.

The honey is jarred in plastic bottles that are fully recyclable and never reused.  Each bottle is sealed with honey that will last forever.  Yes, forever.  Honey is a forever food so if the honey begins to crystallize you can just place it in some warm water and it will soon return to liquid state.

Our eggs are raised by our own chickens, and despite only having a small flock we occasionally have unwashed eggs for sale.  The best chance to get these is by calling ahead or stopping by the farm to pick up your order.  We are always adding to our flock and hope to be able to provide more to our customers soon!

Over time we are always seeking to add more opportunities to provide farm goods to your family, and if there is something we do not carry that you are interested in we encourage you to reach out to us.  We will find someone to connect you with for any farm-to-table goods.
